computed.title: Dynamisch contract zonder sturing
computed.why: DSMR-exported monthly all-in rates are compared with the same retrospective dynamic formula for all three local years; unchanged fixed costs are carried forward and the dynamic subscription is added.
computed.limitation: The export reconciles configured prices to DSMR displayed costs, but fixed supplier, grid, capacity, tax and levy components are not decomposed or independently invoice-validated.

computed.title: Winterse netlading zonder hogere maandpiek
computed.why: Uses cheap Day-Ahead quarters to fill otherwise idle storage while keeping every simulated month at or below its observed peak.
computed.limitation: Perfect foresight on a residual profile; this is not an exact redispatch of the installed battery.

computed.title: Prijsarbitrage met batterij-export
computed.why: Can capture rare high-price intervals after household demand is covered.
computed.limitation: Requires controller, warranty, metering, supplier and regulatory validation; no physical export control has been tested.

computed.title: Extra batterijcapaciteit
computed.why: Adds PV capture and some price arbitrage on the residual profile.
computed.limitation: The perfect-foresight annual value remains too small to support hardware purchase without installed cost and lifetime inputs.

observed_battery_sources: Home Assistant hourly battery statistics 2026-01-22 through 2026-09-30
model.residual_battery_interpretation: additional virtual battery applied after historically observed battery behavior
grid_charging_comparison: price-aware grid charging with perfect foresight and a baseline monthly peak plus 1 kW cap

limitations: Fluvius residual net flow already includes the historical operation of the existing battery; residual scenarios therefore represent additional storage, not a clean replacement of the existing battery.
Sunny Portal provides complete daily battery energy for 2023-2025, but interval battery power only from 2025-05-29 through 2025-12-31.
The 2025-2026 observed battery year is partial because detailed battery data is unavailable for 2026-01-01 through 2026-01-21.
The August 2026 Ecopower dynamic formula is applied retrospectively as a controlled constant-tariff sensitivity across all three years.

The three-year historical comparison uses configured DSMR rates, with owner-confirmed Home Assistant import rates taking precedence for January through September 2026; component scope and VAT inclusion remain unverified.
Residual-battery scenarios use perfect price and residual-load foresight and are upper bounds, not deployable production forecasts.
The six unavailable Fluvius quarters remain excluded from optimization and visible in quality counts.
